{{Otheruses|Lightning}}
The '''lightning module''' was a form of [[DarkStryder technology]], which was powered by the intense energies contained in the [[Lifewell]]. When activated, the lightning module emitted a bolt of pure electricity at a specific target. Like most DarkStryder technology, though, the lightning module was only usable in [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. Any attempt to remove it from the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and use it would result in the destruction of the module.
